title: ID0413281-DC/Si-D/AE - [wRsIIZ] Multiple unsuccessful charging sessions
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Customer attempted to charge at our station but encountered multiple expired session errors, preventing a successful charging session.
Root cause: Timeout in setting up a session from EV
Solution: Answer provided as per the log analysis
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413281-DC/Si-D/AE - [wRsIIZ] Multiple unsuccessful charging sessions CRM:00796001450
additional_info.body:
Hi Nadeem,
Greetings of the day!
Thank you for the detailed information. In the logs, I can see that the issue is due to a timeout (Waiting for "No EV connect" timeout with pilot state: B2) preventing the start of charging. Unfortunately, detailed logs are not available for this outlet as the session is more than 4 days old.
One of the suspected root causes for this issue is battery voltage problems. The battery might be too discharged or could have irregular voltage, preventing the precharge process from completing properly.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
